oneOf.description: Inspect the current document, revision, capabilities and engine.
Read every page/frame and the selected frame text; offsets belong to the selected frame.
Replace a UTF-16 range on grapheme boundaries. Revision and idempotency key are required.
Format a UTF-16 range, retaining explicit font/language and custom spacing.
Atomically save a lab document; detects external changes and protects source files.
Open or migrate a document; fontPaths resolves exact hashes at new paths.
Set dimensions and margins for one page. Full content frames follow its content area.
Undo a document, page, frame, text or formatting transaction.
Redo an undone document transaction.
Inspect loaded font identities and the registered layer recipe.
Privately load a local static TTF without a system font install.
Inspect the page and all its frame glyphs, including overflow.
Map page coordinates to frame identity and native UTF-16 caret.
Render the shared glyph layout to PNG, optionally a bounded tile for a huge page.
Control layer visibility, flat layer colors, preview mode, zoom and overlays.
Toggle kerning and standard ligatures; reuses the same text source.
Select a grapheme-aligned UTF-16 range, optionally in another frame.
Read native accessibility, selection and UI state.
Save a PNG of the lab widget for local troubleshooting.
Read recent correlated diagnostics.
Create a new document; explicit discard is required for unsaved text.
Rename the document.
Validate a file and list exact missing font identities without changing the document.
Save at a new path, retaining the previous document and its recovery history.
List recent local document paths.
Find literal text on grapheme boundaries across all frames.
Replace all literal matches as one undoable transaction.
Set line height, paragraph spacing, alignment and left tab stops.
Add an independent page with a full content frame.
Remove a page and its frames; undo restores all content.
Add an independent text frame to the selected page; coordinates use points.
Select the editing frame and invalidate commands prepared for a previous frame.
Set frame position, dimensions, label and visible/clipped overflow.
Remove a text frame; undo restores its full semantic text.
List named character styles.
Create or replace a named character style.
Apply a named character style to the selected frame range.
Validate and select three compatible fonts for registered flat color.
Apply an explicit three-color palette to the current recipe.
Return plain source text and semantic clipboard data for a selection.
Paste validated semantic clipboard data without discarding run metadata.
List recoverable checkpoints from sessions that are no longer running.
Recover an interrupted session without overwriting its source document.
List revision summaries, undo capacity and the last durable revision.
Export a portable outline SVG proof; bitmap-only glyphs fail explicitly.
